packageRules.description: Everything that ends up in the shipped binary or image produces a patch release (semrel bumps only on fix/feat).
Action bumps change what consumers execute, so they must release a patch (fix): action.yml ships cosign-installer to every consumer job, and workflow action bumps are released too.
CI-only tool versions do not change what consumers run: no release.
Step-level actions keep full semver tags: .github/workflows/actions.lock records and enforces the SHAs, so Renovate must not pin digests here (overrides the preset's pinGitHubActionDigests).
Reusable workflow calls (jobs.<job_id>.uses) are not covered by the lockfile: keep them pinned to a full commit SHA with a version comment.
Steps in the repository's own action.yml are not covered by the lockfile: keep them pinned to a full commit SHA with a version comment.

customManagers.description: CI-only tool versions (golangci-lint, govulncheck) annotated with '# renovate:' comments in ci.yml.
matchStrings: # renovate: datasource=(?<datasource>\S+) depName=(?<depName>\S+)\n\s*(?:- run: go install \S+@|version: )(?<currentValue>v\S+)
